title: Create HeroSection Component Structure
description: Create a new dedicated HeroSection component with proper TypeScript interfaces and component structure following React best practices.
details: Create `src/components/marketing/HeroSection.tsx` with a clean component structure. Define TypeScript interfaces for any props if needed. Set up the basic component skeleton with semantic HTML elements like <section>, <h1>, <h2>, and <div> containers. Ensure the component is properly exported and follows the existing project's component patterns. Use React functional component with TypeScript and include proper JSX structure for the hero layout.
test_strategy: Write unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library to verify the component renders without errors, displays the correct semantic HTML structure, and exports properly. Test that the component accepts and renders any props correctly.

title: Implement Hero Content and Styling
description: Design and implement the visual content of the hero section including compelling headline, subheading, and styling using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.
details: Add compelling headline text that clearly communicates the LLM comparison value proposition (e.g., 'Compare Multiple AI Models Instantly'). Include a descriptive subheading explaining the core functionality. Implement responsive design using Tailwind CSS utility classes for typography, spacing, and layout. Use existing shadcn/ui components like Button and Card where appropriate. Ensure the design is visually engaging with proper contrast, typography hierarchy, and whitespace. Make the section fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
test_strategy: Test responsive design across different screen sizes using browser dev tools. Verify text content renders correctly and is accessible. Test color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards. Use visual regression testing tools to ensure consistent appearance.

title: Add Call-to-Action Button with Navigation
description: Implement a prominent CTA button that guides users to the main comparison interface with proper interaction handling.
details: Add a primary CTA button using the shadcn/ui Button component with appropriate styling (likely 'default' or 'primary' variant). Implement click handler that smoothly scrolls to the comparison form section on the same page or navigates appropriately. Ensure the button is keyboard accessible with proper focus states and ARIA attributes. Position the CTA prominently within the hero layout and make it visually distinct. Add hover and active states for better user feedback.
test_strategy: Test button click functionality and navigation behavior. Verify keyboard accessibility (Tab navigation, Enter/Space activation). Test focus management and ARIA attributes with screen readers. Ensure button styling is consistent with the design system.

title: Integrate HeroSection into Main Page
description: Replace the existing hero section in the main page with the new HeroSection component and ensure proper integration.
details: Modify `src/app/page.tsx` to import and use the new HeroSection component. Remove any existing hero section code and replace it with `<HeroSection />`. Ensure the component integrates seamlessly with the existing page layout and doesn't break the overall page structure. Verify that the hero section appears at the top of the page and flows naturally into the rest of the content. Test that all existing functionality on the page continues to work correctly.
test_strategy: Perform end-to-end testing to ensure the main page loads correctly with the new hero section. Test that the CTA button properly navigates to the comparison interface. Verify no layout shifts or broken styles. Test page performance metrics (LCP, CLS) to ensure no regression in Core Web Vitals.
